title: AI-use policy
description: Which data may go where, by how sensitive it is. A policy may hold more than this schema names; readers keep what they do not use. Format 1 is fixed: fields may be added, but none is renamed, dropped or given a new meaning, and the lists of classes and actions do not change; anything else is format 2.

approvedServers.description: Model servers trusted more than others, by address. A conversation to one follows desktop_approved, which falls back to desktop_remote where a class does not say.

classes.description: For each class, what happens at each place data could go. A place left out follows desktop_remote; desktop_remote and desktop_local left out allow.

additionalProperties.description: desktop_local: a model on this computer. desktop_approved: a model server in approvedServers (desktop_remote where left out). desktop_remote: anything else that leaves it, such as another model server or a connector. Other places (a platform's own) may be listed too.
